42	def reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation(
43	    output_tensor: torch.Tensor,
44	    input_tensor: torch.Tensor,
45	    op: torch.distributed.ReduceOp,
46	    group: torch.distributed.ProcessGroup,
47	    async_op: bool,
48	    all_to_all_output_tensor: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
49	):
50	    """Reduce-scatter with FP32 accumulation.
51	
52	    Collects input_tensor in lower precision using an all-to-all, then locally accumulates in FP32
53	    precision, then downcasts final sum back into right location in input_tensor.
54	
55	
56	    Args:
57	        output_tensor (torch.Tensor): Output tensor with reduce-scattered output (only the shard).
58	        input_tensor (torch.Tensor): Input tensor that needs to be reduce-scattered.
59	        op (torch.distributed.ReduceOp): Only torch.distributed.ReduceOp.SUM is supported.
60	        group (torch.distributed.ProcessGroup): Process group to use for reduce-scatter.
61	        async_op (bool): Only False is supported right now.
62	        all_to_all_output_tensor (torch.Tensor, optional): Caller-provided scratch matching
63	            input_tensor's shape and dtype, for callers with their own buffer pool. Allocated
64	            internally when omitted; must stay alive until .wait() returns.
65	    """
66	    # Make sure arguments conform to the implementation.
67	    assert op == torch.distributed.ReduceOp.SUM
68	
69	    # Get world_size.
70	    if group is None:
71	        world_size = torch.distributed.get_world_size()
72	    else:
73	        world_size = group.size()
74	
75	    # Make sure input_tensor size is divisible by world size.
76	    assert input_tensor.numel() % world_size == 0
77	
78	    # Call all_to_all (every rank should have their respective gradient shards collected from
79	    # all ranks). We also create a tensor for the all-to-all output (the all-to-all collective
80	    # cannot be performed in-place).
81	    if all_to_all_output_tensor is None:
82	        all_to_all_output_tensor = torch.empty_like(input_tensor)
83	    else:
84	        assert all_to_all_output_tensor.shape == input_tensor.shape, (
85	            f"all_to_all_output_tensor shape {tuple(all_to_all_output_tensor.shape)} does not "
86	            f"match input_tensor shape {tuple(input_tensor.shape)}"
87	        )
88	        assert all_to_all_output_tensor.dtype == input_tensor.dtype
89	    all_to_all_handle = torch.distributed.all_to_all_single(
90	        output=all_to_all_output_tensor, input=input_tensor, group=group, async_op=async_op
91	    )
92	
93	    # Create a work handle to finish communication and reduction.
94	    reduce_scatter_handle = _ReduceScatterWithFP32AccumulationWorkHandle(
95	        all_to_all_handle, all_to_all_output_tensor, output_tensor, world_size
96	    )
97	    if async_op:
98	        # Return work handle; consumers can call .wait() to ensure communication and associated
99	        # reduction complete.
100	        return reduce_scatter_handle
101	    else:
102	        # Wait on work handle.
103	        reduce_scatter_handle.wait()

23	class _BucketParamReadyCallback:
24	    """Publishes one bucket group's parameters on demand.
25	
26	    DDP's side of ``megatron.core.utils.ensure_params_ready``: one instance is stored on every
27	    parameter of the group under ``PARAM_READY_CALLBACK_ATTR``, and calling it makes those
28	    parameters readable. For consumers reading ``param.data`` ahead of the owning module's
29	    pre-hook.
30	
31	    Publishing may START an undispatched gather, not just wait on one. Holds DDP and the bucket
32	    group weakly; the callback outlives this DDP on re-wrap. No-ops under CUDA-graph capture, so
33	    a consumer that captures its reads must replay this itself.
34	    """
35	
36	    def __init__(self, ddp: 'DistributedDataParallel', bucket_group) -> None:
37	        self._ddp = weakref.ref(ddp)
38	        self._bucket_group = weakref.ref(bucket_group)
39	
40	    def __call__(self) -> None:
41	        bucket_group = self._bucket_group()
42	        if bucket_group is None:
43	            return
44	
45	        # HOT PATH: already published. True for every microbatch after the first one of an
46	        # iteration, so it precedes the DDP deref and the graph-capture query.
47	        if bucket_group.param_gather_dispatched and bucket_group.param_gather_handle is None:
48	            return
49	
50	        ddp = self._ddp()
51	        if ddp is None:
52	            # Weakref is dead: the DDP object was garbage-collected while this callback lived on
53	            # (it is stored on the parameters, which outlive the wrapper). Its buffers are gone.
54	            return
55	
56	        if is_graph_capturing():
57	            # A captured collective re-runs on EVERY replay: once per microbatch, not once per
58	            # iteration. Consumers that capture their reads must publish before launching.
59	            return
60	
61	        # No pre-hooks installed means the caller removed them and now drives param sync itself
62	        # (``disable_forward_pre_hook(param_sync=False)``), so the schedule is not ours to touch.
63	        ddp_owns_schedule = bool(ddp.remove_forward_pre_hook_handles)
64	
65	        if bucket_group.param_gather_handle is not None:
66	            # A gather is in flight over the very buffer we are about to read, so it must be
67	            # waited on. finish_param_sync() does two things: wait for THIS bucket, then start
68	            # the NEXT bucket's gather. The wait is mandatory; starting the next bucket is a
69	            # scheduling decision, so only let it happen while DDP still owns the schedule.
70	            if ddp_owns_schedule:
71	                ddp._finish_param_sync_for_bucket_group(bucket_group)
72	            else:
73	                bucket_group.finish_param_sync(skip_next_bucket_dispatch=True)
74	        elif ddp_owns_schedule:
75	            # No handle and not published (the hot path returned above) => never dispatched, so
76	            # publishing STARTS a gather. Only safe while DDP owns the schedule.
77	            assert not bucket_group.param_gather_dispatched
78	            ddp._finish_param_sync_for_bucket_group(bucket_group)

81	class DistributedDataParallel(_BaseDataParallel):
82	    """
83	    DDP wrapper which stores grads in contiguous buffers. Also has option of overlapping
84	    communication with backprop computation by breaking up full model's gradients into smaller
85	    buckets and running all-reduce / reduce-scatter on each bucket asynchronously. This class
86	    also provides the option to do the gradient accumulation in a type other than the param type
87	    (e.g., fp32 for a bf16 model).
88	
89	    Args:
90	        config: Transformer config object.
91	        ddp_config: DistributedDataParallel config object.
92	        module: Underlying model.
93	        disable_bucketing: If true, force assign all parameters to a single bucket. If false,
94	            use standard bucketing policy: assign parameters to smaller buckets and all-reduce
95	            per bucket _if_ overlap_grad_reduce is True and pp_rank is 0.
96	        pg_collection: Optional unified process group for distributed training.
97	        full_param_layout: Optional FullParamLayout providing pre-computed layouts for all
98	            dtype groups. When provided, each buffer uses the corresponding PerBufferParamLayout
99	            instead of computing a default one.
100	
101	    """
102	
103	    def __init__(
104	        self,
105	        config: TransformerConfig,
106	        ddp_config: DistributedDataParallelConfig,
107	        module: torch.nn.Module,
108	        disable_bucketing: bool = False,
109	        pg_collection: Optional[ProcessGroupCollection] = None,
110	        full_param_layout: Optional[FullParamLayout] = None,
111	    ):

113	        if has_config_logger_enabled(config):
114	            log_config_to_disk(config, locals(), prefix=type(self).__name__)
115	
116	        # If bucket_size is not provided as an input, use sane default.
117	        # If using very large dp_sizes, make buckets larger to ensure that chunks used in NCCL
118	        # ring-reduce implementations are large enough to remain bandwidth-bound rather than
119	        # latency-bound.

234	            "over the GTP-excluded group and would miss the 1/gtp_remat gradient scaling factor."
235	        )
236	
237	        # Compute gradient scaling factors.
238	        if config.calculate_per_token_loss:
239	            assert (
240	                not self.ddp_config.average_in_collective
241	            ), "Cannot average in collective when calculating per-token loss!"

243	            expert_gradient_scaling_factor = 1.0
244	        else:
245	            # The goal is to scale reduced gradients by 1/dp_size.
246	            # This can be achieved in two ways:
247	            #
248	            # Case 1: average_in_collective=True
249	            # - Non-expert parameters:
250	            #   1. No pre-scaling (gradient_scaling_factor=1.0)
251	            #   2. Do average reduction over dp group (equals to sum then divide by dp_size)
252	            #   3. Final result is scaled by 1/dp_size as desired
253	            #
254	            # - Expert parameters:
255	            #   1. Scale by edp_size/dp_size before reduction
256	            #   2. Do average reduction over edp group (equals to sum then divide by edp_size)
257	            #   3. Resulted scaling: (edp_size/dp_size) * (1/edp_size) = 1/dp_size as desired
258	            #   (edp_size = expert data parallel world size)
259	            #
260	            # Case 2: average_in_collective=False
261	            # - Both expert and non-expert parameters:
262	            #   1. Scale gradients by 1/dp_size before reduction
263	            #   2. Do sum reduction across data parallel ranks
264	            #   3. Final result is scaled by 1/dp_size as desired
265	            if self.ddp_config.average_in_collective:
266	                gradient_scaling_factor = 1.0
267	                expert_gradient_scaling_factor = self.expt_dp_group.size() / self.dp_cp_group.size()
268	            else:
269	                data_parallel_world_size = self.dp_cp_group.size()
270	
271	                gradient_scaling_factor = 1.0 / data_parallel_world_size
272	                expert_gradient_scaling_factor = 1.0 / data_parallel_world_size
273	
274	        # Allocate buffers for each group.
275	        self.buffers = []
276	        self.expert_parallel_buffers = []
277	        pg_collection = ProcessGroupCollection(tp=self.tp_group, dp_cp=self.dp_cp_group)
278	        for buffer_key, (params, param_indices) in buffer_groups.items():
279	            if buffer_key.is_expert_parallel:
280	                data_parallel_group = self.intra_expt_dp_group
281	                scaling_factor = expert_gradient_scaling_factor
282	            else:
283	                data_parallel_group = self.intra_dp_cp_group
284	                scaling_factor = gradient_scaling_factor
285	
286	            if not config.calculate_per_token_loss:
287	                target_gradient_scaling_factor = 1.0 / self.dp_cp_group.size()
288	                if self.ddp_config.average_in_collective:
289	                    if self.ddp_config.num_distributed_optimizer_instances == 1:
290	                        # Collective is averaging gradients in collective with data_parallel_group.
291	                        assert (
292	                            scaling_factor / data_parallel_group.size()
293	                            == target_gradient_scaling_factor
294	                        )
295	                    else:
296	                        # For non-expert parameters, gradient_scaling_factor is 1.
297	                        # For expert parameters, gradient_scaling_factor is edp_size/dp_size.
298	                        assert (scaling_factor == 1) or (
299	                            scaling_factor == (self.expt_dp_group.size() / self.dp_cp_group.size())
300	                        )
301	                else:
302	                    assert scaling_factor == target_gradient_scaling_factor
303	
304	            param_layout = (
305	                full_param_layout.layouts.get(buffer_key) if full_param_layout is not None else None
306	            )
307	            params_with_names = [(p, param_to_name[p]) for p in params]
308	            buffer = _ParamAndGradBuffer(
309	                self.ddp_config,
310	                buffer_key.param_dtype,
311	                buffer_key.grad_dtype,
312	                params_with_names,
313	                data_parallel_group,
314	                self.bucket_size,
315	                param_to_name,
316	                scaling_factor,
317	                param_indices,
318	                self.ddp_config.nccl_ub,
319	                pg_collection,
320	                param_layout=param_layout,
321	            )

323	                self.expert_parallel_buffers.append(buffer)
324	            else:
325	                self.buffers.append(buffer)

327	        # In some scenarios, we want to put buckets from different buffers into a group so that
328	        # their communication can be aggregated. For example, when there are both fp8 buffers
329	        # and bf16 buffers in the model and vpp is enabled, each model chunk will have an fp8
330	        # bucket and a bf16 bucket, which doubles the number of communication kernels, and
331	        # because of the use of CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=1, having multiple back-to-back
332	        # communications will prevent the overlap of the communication kernels with computation
333	        # kernels.

335	        # bucket group.

337	            self.buffers,
338	            force_single_bucket_group=disable_bucketing,
339	            reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation=(
340	                self.ddp_config.reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation
341	            ),
342	        )
343	        self.expert_parallel_bucket_groups = partition_buckets(
344	            self.expert_parallel_buffers,
345	            force_single_bucket_group=disable_bucketing,
346	            reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation=(
347	                self.ddp_config.reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation
348	            ),
349	        )
350	
351	        if self.ddp_config.num_distributed_optimizer_instances > 1:
352	            assert (
353	                self.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer
354	            ), 'Partial DistOpt cannot be used without DistOpt'
355	            for bucket_groups in [self.bucket_groups, self.expert_parallel_bucket_groups]:
356	                communication_stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=torch.cuda.current_device())
357	                for bucket_group in bucket_groups:
358	                    bucket_group.inter_distributed_optimizer_instance_group = (
359	                        self.inter_dist_opt_group
360	                    )
361	                    bucket_group.communication_stream = communication_stream
362	
363	        # Set `next_param_gather_bucket_group` for different bucket groups by iterating through
364	        # buckets in reverse order (since all-gathers happen in reverse order of buckets).
365	        # Note: overlap_param_gather covers both the distributed optimizer and the
366	        # layer-wise optimizer cases; the latter sets overlap_param_gather=True
367	        # without use_distributed_optimizer.
368	        if self.ddp_config.overlap_param_gather:
369	            for bucket_groups in [self.bucket_groups, self.expert_parallel_bucket_groups]:
370	                num_bucket_groups = len(bucket_groups)
371	                for i in range(1, num_bucket_groups):
372	                    bucket_groups[num_bucket_groups - i].next_param_gather_bucket_group = (
373	                        bucket_groups[num_bucket_groups - i - 1]
374	                    )
375	
376	        # Set `previous_grad_reduce_bucket_group` so each bucket group can drain its predecessor's
377	        # reduce-scatter at dispatch time. Only needed for reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation,
378	        # which holds an intermediate all-to-all output tensor pinned until .wait() runs; without

380	        # num_distributed_optimizer_instances == 1 elsewhere, so we only link in that case.
381	        # Grad-reduce dispatches happen in forward order of bucket_groups during backward (buckets
382	        # closer to the output finish their gradients first), so bucket_groups[i]'s immediate
383	        # predecessor in dispatch order is bucket_groups[i-1].
384	        if (
385	            self.ddp_config.overlap_grad_reduce
386	            and self.ddp_config.reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation
387	            and self.ddp_config.num_distributed_optimizer_instances == 1
388	        ):
389	            for bucket_groups in [self.bucket_groups, self.expert_parallel_bucket_groups]:
390	                for i in range(1, len(bucket_groups)):
391	                    bucket_groups[i].previous_grad_reduce_bucket_group = bucket_groups[i - 1]
392	
393	        # Create map from param to bucket group, used in pre_hook.
394	        for bucket_groups in [self.bucket_groups, self.expert_parallel_bucket_groups]:
395	            for bucket_group in bucket_groups:
396	                # One readiness callback per bucket group, stamped on all its params, so a
397	                # consumer reading param.data outside the owning module's pre-hook can publish it
398	                # first. Backend-agnostic: DDP never learns which consumers use it.
399	                ready_callback = (
400	                    _BucketParamReadyCallback(self, bucket_group)
401	                    if self.ddp_config.overlap_param_gather
402	                    else None
403	                )
404	                for bucket in bucket_group.buckets:
405	                    for param in bucket.params_list:
406	                        self.param_to_bucket_group[param] = bucket_group
407	                        if ready_callback is not None:
408	                            setattr(param, PARAM_READY_CALLBACK_ATTR, ready_callback)
409	                        elif hasattr(param, PARAM_READY_CALLBACK_ATTR):
410	                            # Re-wrapping a model chunk: a previous DDP may have left a marker
411	                            # pointing at ITS bucket group. This DDP owns the parameter now and
412	                            # publishes nothing, so the stale callback must go.
413	                            delattr(param, PARAM_READY_CALLBACK_ATTR)
414	
415	        # Delete references to weight_tensor if they exist since we don't want two parameter copies
416	        # if we re-mapped parameters (which happens when we use the distributed optimizer).
417	        # This is a temporary workaround around a TE bug that is fixed with
418	        # https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/pull/719.
419	        if self.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer:
420	
421	            @torch.no_grad()
422	            def unmap_weight_tensor(m):
423	                if hasattr(m, 'weight_tensor'):
424	                    m.weight_tensor = None
425	
426	            self.module.apply(unmap_weight_tensor)
427	
428	        # Register backward hook.
429	        # Accumulation function for the gradients need to be stored so they
430	        # don't go out of scope.
431	        self.grad_accs = []
432	        for param in self.module.parameters():
433	            if param.requires_grad:
434	                # When delay_wgrad_compute is True and the param is marked with
435	                # skip_backward_post_hook, register the backward post hook for its module
436	                # instead of the param so that the wgrad accumulation and reduce will be performed
437	                # in backward_dw() method of the module instead of the hook of backward() method.
438	                # Otherwise, register the backward post hook for the param.
439	                if self.ddp_config.delay_wgrad_compute and getattr(
440	                    param, 'skip_backward_post_hook', False
441	                ):
442	                    for module in self.module.modules():
443	                        if hasattr(module, "register_wgrad_accumulation_and_reduce_hooks"):
444	                            for param_value in module.parameters():
445	                                if param is param_value:
446	                                    module.register_wgrad_accumulation_and_reduce_hooks(
447	                                        self._make_backward_post_hook(param)
448	                                    )
449	                                    break
450	                else:
451	                    # Expand so we get access to grad_fn.
452	                    param_tmp = param.expand_as(param)
453	                    # Get the gradient accumulator function.
454	                    grad_acc = param_tmp.grad_fn.next_functions[0][0]
455	                    if getattr(param, 'is_gtp_weight_remat', False) and hasattr(
456	                        param, 'register_grad_accum_hook'
457	                    ):
458	                        # GTP_remat computes wgrad via an async reduce-scatter, so autograd's

460	                        # _handle_megatron_grad_accum (the hook passed here). RETAINING the node

462	                        # No autograd hook or grad_accs entry: either would fire on a stale grad.
463	                        param.register_grad_accum_hook(
464	                            grad_acc, self._make_backward_post_hook(param)
465	                        )

467	                        grad_acc.register_hook(self._make_backward_post_hook(param))
468	                        self.grad_accs.append(grad_acc)

471	        # layer-wise optimizer cases; the latter sets overlap_param_gather=True
472	        # without use_distributed_optimizer.
473	        self.use_forward_hook = self.ddp_config.overlap_param_gather
474	        self.remove_forward_pre_hook_handles = {}
475	        if self.use_forward_hook:
476	            self.enable_forward_pre_hook()
477	        self.overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step = False

479	    def enable_forward_pre_hook(self):
480	        """
481	        Enable forward pre-hooks needed for param all-gather overlap with forward compute.
482	        """
483	        assert self.use_forward_hook
484	        assert len(self.remove_forward_pre_hook_handles) == 0
485	        # Register forward pre-hook for all sub-modules.
486	        for module in self.module.modules():
487	            self.remove_forward_pre_hook_handles[module] = module.register_forward_pre_hook(
488	                self._make_forward_pre_hook()
489	            )
490	
491	    def disable_forward_pre_hook(self, param_sync: bool = True):
492	        """
493	        Disable forward pre-hooks needed for param all-gather overlap with forward compute.
494	        Skip synchronous param all-gather if `param_sync` is False.
495	        """
496	        assert self.use_forward_hook
497	        # De-register forward pre-hook for all sub-modules.
498	        for module in self.module.modules():
499	            assert self.remove_forward_pre_hook_handles[module] is not None
500	            self.remove_forward_pre_hook_handles[module].remove()
501	            del self.remove_forward_pre_hook_handles[module]
502	        assert len(self.remove_forward_pre_hook_handles) == 0
503	
504	        # Force synchronize parameters.
505	        if param_sync:
506	            # Hook-disable paths (eval/checkpointing/shutdown) synchronize params as an
507	            # explicit state update, not as differentiable forward compute.
508	            with torch.no_grad():
509	                self.start_param_sync(force_sync=True)

511	    def _make_forward_pre_hook(self):
512	        """
513	        Create a forward pre-hook to wait on all-gather handles when necessary (i.e.,
514	        when a module uses a parameter in a bucket with a still incomplete all-gather).
515	        """
516	
517	        def hook(module, *unused):
518	            assert (
519	                self.use_forward_hook
520	            ), "Should use pre-hook only when overlap_param_gather is True"
521	
522	            if is_graph_capturing():
523	                return
524	
525	            # Make sure all parameters in this module have been all-gathered as necessary.
526	            for param in module.parameters(recurse=False):
527	                # Skip parameters without an associated buffer (such parameters have a
528	                # .requires_grad field equal to False).
529	                if param not in self.param_to_bucket_group:
530	                    continue
531	                assert param.requires_grad
532	                self._finish_param_sync_for_bucket_group(self.param_to_bucket_group[param])
533	
534	        return hook
535	
536	    def _finish_param_sync_for_bucket_group(self, bucket_group):
537	        """Drain one bucket group's param all-gather and run its post-all-gather processing."""
538	        # If aligning param all-gather across pipeline stages, all-gather is dispatched
539	        # by start_param_sync calls in core/pipeline_parallelism/schedules.py.
540	        # If overlapping param all-gather with optimizer step, then all-gather has
541	        # already been dispatched in optimizer step.
542	        skip_next_bucket_dispatch = (
543	            self.ddp_config.align_param_gather or self.overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step
544	        )
545	        bucket_group.finish_param_sync(skip_next_bucket_dispatch=skip_next_bucket_dispatch)

547	    def _make_backward_post_hook(self, param: torch.nn.Parameter):
548	        """
549	        Creates a backward post-hook to dispatch an all-reduce / reduce-scatter when
550	        ready (i.e., when all grads in a bucket have been computed in all microbatches
551	        in a batch).
552	        """
553	
554	        def hook(*unused):
555	            if is_graph_capturing():
556	                return
557	
558	            if param in self.param_to_bucket_group:
559	                assert param.requires_grad
560	                cudagraph_wgrad_ready_event = getattr(param, '_cudagraph_wgrad_ready_event', None)
561	                if self.ddp_config.overlap_grad_reduce and cudagraph_wgrad_ready_event is None:
562	                    # GTP_remat keeps its real wgrad in main_grad (via finalize); param.grad here is
563	                    # throwaway (None or a dummy), so skip this assert and rely on
564	                    # grad_added_to_main_grad below.
565	                    if not getattr(param, 'is_gtp_weight_remat', False):
566	                        assert (
567	                            param.grad is not None
568	                        ), 'param.grad being None is not safe when overlap_grad_reduce is True'
569	                if param.grad is not None and (
570	                    not param.grad_added_to_main_grad or getattr(param, 'zero_out_wgrad', False)
571	                ):
572	                    param.main_grad.add_(param.grad.data)
573	                param.grad = None
574	
575	                if self.ddp_config.overlap_grad_reduce:
576	                    self.param_to_bucket_group[param].register_grad_ready(
577	                        param, self.force_all_reduce
578	                    )

580	        return hook

583	    def no_sync(self):
584	        """
585	        Context manager that turns off gradient synchronization.
586	        """
587	        for bucket_group in self.bucket_groups + self.expert_parallel_bucket_groups:
588	            bucket_group.is_last_microbatch = False

590	            yield

595	    def _start_bucket_group_param_sync(
596	        self, bucket_group: '_ParamAndGradBucketGroup', force_sync: bool
597	    ) -> None:
598	        """Dispatch one bucket group's param all-gather + run the FP8 / MXFP8 / FP4
599	        post-all-gather work the synchronous path needs.

602	        of bucket groups (e.g. a chained ``LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer`` +

613	    def start_param_sync(self, *unused, force_sync: bool = False, force_dispatch: bool = False):
614	        """
615	        Initiates param sync (all-gather) communication operations for all model parameters.
616	
617	        By default, when overlap_param_gather is set to True, dispatches asynchronous communication
618	        calls; when overlap_param_gather is set to False, calls synchronous communication
619	        ops. Can override this default behavior using flags below.
620	
621	        Args:
622	            force_sync (bool, optional): force synchronous collective regardless of
623	                other settings.
624	            force_dispatch (bool, optional): force dispatch regardless of other settings.
625	        """
626	        if not force_sync:
627	            # If overlapping param AG with optimizer step, AG should not be dispatched again
628	            # in forward_backward_step.
629	            if self.overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step and not force_dispatch:
630	                return

632	        for bucket_group in self.bucket_groups + self.expert_parallel_bucket_groups:
633	            self._start_bucket_group_param_sync(bucket_group, force_sync=force_sync)

635	    def reset_param_sync_dispatch_state(self):
636	        """Mark DDP param all-gathers as not dispatched for the next forward pre-hook."""
637	        for bucket_group in self.bucket_groups + self.expert_parallel_bucket_groups:
638	            # A non-None handle means the previous all-gather is still in flight. Resetting only
639	            # the dispatch flag would create the invalid state
640	            # `param_gather_dispatched=False, param_gather_handle!=None` and could dispatch a

644	                "parameter all-gather is still in flight."

682	    def zero_grad_buffer(self):
683	        """
684	        Zeros out all grad buffers. Needs to be called at the beginning of each
685	        training iteration.
686	        """
687	        if getattr(self.config, 'cuda_graph_impl', 'none') != 'transformer_engine':

698	    def broadcast_params(self):
699	        """
700	        Syncs parameters across all DP ranks.
701	        """
702	        for param in self.module.parameters():
703	            is_expert_parallel = not getattr(param, 'allreduce', True)
704	
705	            if is_expert_parallel:
706	                data_parallel_group = self.expt_dp_group
707	            else:
708	                data_parallel_group = self.dp_cp_group
709	            torch.distributed.broadcast(
710	                param.data,
711	                src=torch.distributed.get_global_rank(data_parallel_group, 0),
712	                group=data_parallel_group,
713	            )

715	    def offload_grad_buffers(self, synchronize: bool = True, empty_cache: bool = True) -> None:
716	        """
717	        Free all grad_data tensors to release GPU memory.
718	
719	        Uses storage().resize_(0) to release memory while keeping tensor views intact.
720	        All bucket.grad_data and param.main_grad views remain valid tensor objects
721	        (though accessing them during offload is undefined behavior).
722	
723	        Args:
724	            synchronize: Whether to call torch.cuda.synchronize() before freeing.
725	            empty_cache: Whether to call torch.cuda.empty_cache() after freeing.
726	        """
727	        if synchronize:
728	            torch.cuda.synchronize()
729	
730	        for buffer in self.buffers + self.expert_parallel_buffers:
731	            buffer.offload_to_cpu(move_params=False, move_grads=True)
732	
733	        if empty_cache:
734	            torch.cuda.empty_cache()

736	    def restore_grad_buffers(self, synchronize: bool = True) -> None:
737	        """
738	        Reallocate grad_data tensors on GPU.
739	
740	        All existing views (bucket.grad_data, param.main_grad) automatically
741	        become valid again since they share the same storage. The grad_data
742	        is zeroed after reallocation.
743	
744	        Args:
745	            synchronize: Whether to call torch.cuda.synchronize() after allocation.
746	        """

748	            buffer.reload_from_cpu(move_params=False, move_grads=True)
749	
750	        if synchronize:
751	            torch.cuda.synchronize()

69	def shard_buffer(buffer: torch.Tensor, data_parallel_world_size: int):
70	    """
71	    Shard buffer into data_parallel_world_size chunks of equal size.
72	    """
73	    assert buffer.numel() % data_parallel_world_size == 0
74	    shard_size = buffer.numel() // data_parallel_world_size
75	    sharded_buffer = [
76	        buffer[(r * shard_size) : ((r + 1) * shard_size)] for r in range(data_parallel_world_size)
77	    ]
78	    return sharded_buffer

81	def _param_uses_quantized_storage(param: torch.nn.Parameter) -> bool:
82	    """Return whether the parameter owns TE quantized storage instead of plain tensor storage."""
83	    # In TE2, is_float8tensor() checks QuantizedTensor, so it includes plain MXFP8Tensor.
84	    # Grouped quantized params are GroupedTensor wrappers, so check their backing storage.
85	    return (
86	        is_float8tensor(param)
87	        or is_nvfp4tensor(param)
88	        or is_grouped_tensor_with_quantized_storage(param)

92	class _ParamAndGradBucket:
93	    """
94	    Bucket to keep track of a subset of the model's parameters and gradients.
95	
96	    Args:
97	        params: List of parameters whose gradients are collated in this bucket.
98	        param_data: View in _ParamAndGradBuffer.param_data that this bucket is responsible for.
99	        grad_data: View in _ParamAndGradBuffer.grad_data that this bucket is responsible for.
100	        offset: Offset of this bucket's view in the larger _ParamAndGradBuffer.
101	        numel_unpadded: Number of unpadded elements in bucket.
102	        gradient_scaling_factor: This factor is utilized to scale gradients prior to their
103	            communication. Its application is twofold: it facilitates the averaging of gradients
104	            and the scaling of gradients in the context of the Mixture of Experts (MoE) model.
105	        bucket_id: Index of bucket in buffer.
106	        param_index_map: Mapping from param to (start, end, bucket_id) in the global buffer.
107	            Used to derive bucket-local offsets for param_to_index.
108	        params_with_extra_main_grads: List of parameters in this bucket that require a
109	            separate higher-precision main_grad tensor for local gradient accumulation.
110	    """
111	
112	    def __init__(
113	        self,
114	        params: List[torch.nn.Parameter],
115	        param_data: Optional[torch.Tensor],
116	        grad_data: torch.Tensor,
117	        offset: int,
118	        numel_unpadded: int,
119	        gradient_scaling_factor: float,
120	        bucket_id: int,
121	        param_index_map: Dict[torch.nn.Parameter, tuple],
122	        params_with_extra_main_grads: List[torch.nn.Parameter],
123	    ):
124	        self.params_list = params
125	        self.params = set(params)
126	        # Make sure there are no duplicate params.
127	        assert len(self.params_list) == len(self.params)
128	        self.param_data = param_data
129	        self.grad_data = grad_data
130	        # The distributed optimizer needs to keep track of this bucket's offset
131	        # within the full grad_buffer.
132	        self.offset = offset
133	        self.numel_unpadded = numel_unpadded
134	        self.gradient_scaling_factor = gradient_scaling_factor
135	        self.bucket_id = bucket_id
136	        # Derive bucket-local param offsets from the global param_index_map.
137	        self.param_to_index = {}
138	        for param in params:
139	            global_start, global_end, _ = param_index_map[param]
140	            self.param_to_index[param] = (global_start - offset, global_end - offset)
141	        self.params_with_extra_main_grads = params_with_extra_main_grads
142	
143	        # Layer-wise optimizer attributes for async param gather.
144	        self.layerwise_params_list = None
145	        self.layerwise_param_flat_sizes = None
146	        self.layerwise_gather_list = None
147	
148	    def set_layerwise_params_list(self, layerwise_params_list: List[List[torch.nn.Parameter]]):
149	        """Set per-rank parameter lists for layer-wise async all-gather.
150	
151	        Args:
152	            layerwise_params_list: List of param lists, one per rank in the DP group.
153	                Each inner list contains the parameters owned by that rank's
154	                layer-wise optimizer that also belong to this bucket.
155	        """
156	        self.layerwise_params_list = layerwise_params_list
157	        self.layerwise_param_flat_sizes = [
158	            sum([p.numel() for p in param_list]) for param_list in layerwise_params_list
159	        ]

162	class _LayerwiseAllGatherHandle:
163	    """Handle wrapping multiple async all-gather work objects.
164	
165	    NCCL guarantees in-order completion on the same communicator, so waiting
166	    on only the last handle is sufficient.
167	    """
168	
169	    def __init__(self, handles):
170	        self.handles = handles
171	
172	    def wait(self):
173	        """Wait on the last handle and clear all handles."""
174	        if self.handles:
175	            self.handles[-1].wait()
176	        self.handles = None

179	class _ParamAndGradBucketGroup:
180	    """
181	    Put multiple buckets into a group so that their communications can be aggregated together.
182	    Provides functionality to register when params in the bucket group have grads ready to be
183	    synced; an asynchronous communication call is automatically launched when _all_ params in
184	    the bucket group have grads ready.
185	
186	    Args:
187	        buckets: A list of buckets.
188	        ddp_config: DistributedDataParallel config object.
189	        collective_group: intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_group if using distributed
190	            optimizer, data_parallel_group if not.
191	        collective_group_size: World size using the intra data-parallel group.
192	    """
193	
194	    def __init__(
195	        self,
196	        buckets: List[_ParamAndGradBucket],
197	        ddp_config: DistributedDataParallelConfig,
198	        collective_group: torch.distributed.ProcessGroup,
199	        collective_group_size: int,
200	    ):
201	        self.buckets = buckets
202	        self.ddp_config = ddp_config
203	
204	        # overlap_param_gather covers the layer-wise optimizer case, which sets
205	        # overlap_param_gather=True without use_distributed_optimizer.
206	        if self.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer or self.ddp_config.overlap_param_gather:
207	            self.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_group = collective_group
208	            self.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_size = collective_group_size
209	            self.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_rank = collective_group.rank()
210	        if not self.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer:
211	            self.data_parallel_group = collective_group
212	
213	        # State for bookkeeping: params is the set of parameters this bucket group is
214	        # responsible for, param_to_bucket maps params to the corresponding bucket.
215	        self.param_to_bucket = {}
216	        self.params = set()
217	        for bucket in self.buckets:
218	            for param in bucket.params_list:
219	                self.param_to_bucket[param] = bucket
220	                self.params.add(param)
221	
222	        self.next_param_gather_bucket_group = None
223	        # Set in DistributedDataParallel.__init__ when reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation is on:
224	        # points to the bucket group whose grad-reduce was dispatched immediately before mine in
225	        # the backward pass. start_grad_sync drains this predecessor before dispatching its own
226	        # collective, so the predecessor's intermediate all-to-all buffer is freed before the new
227	        # one is allocated.
228	        self.previous_grad_reduce_bucket_group = None
229	
230	        if self.ddp_config.num_distributed_optimizer_instances > 1:
231	            self.inter_distributed_optimizer_instance_group = None
232	            self.communication_stream = None
233	            assert (
234	                not self.ddp_config.reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation
235	            ), "RS w/ FP32 accumulation not supported with num_distributed_optimizer_instances > 1"
236	
237	        reduction_collective = (
238	            "reduce-scatter" if self.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer else "all-reduce"
239	        )
240	        log_single_rank(
241	            logger,
242	            logging.INFO,
243	            f"Using {reduction_collective} for gradient reductions because "
244	            f"{self.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer=}",
245	        )
246	
247	        global dist_reduce_scatter_func
248	        if self.ddp_config.reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation:
249	            dist_reduce_scatter_func = reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation
250	            log_single_rank(
251	                logger,
252	                logging.INFO,
253	                "Using reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation as reduce-scatter implementation",
254	            )
255	
256	        # per_param_grad_ready_counts is a dict mapping parameters to number of times
257	        # `register_grad_ready` is called for that parameter *when
258	        # self.is_last_microbatch is True*. Should be 1 for most params but could be greater
259	        # than 1 if control flow passes through the same parameter multiple times. We lazily
260	        # populate this in the first batch, hence the .is_first_batch attribute.
261	        # When overlap_grad_reduce is True, communication (all-reduce or reduce-scatter)
262	        # is issued when per_param_grad_ready_counts equals golden_per_param_grad_ready_counts.
263	        # In other words, communication is dispatched as soon as all gradients in this bucket
264	        # are *ready*, as marked by the backward hook.
265	        # The set of keys in per_param_grad_ready_counts should be equal to `params`.
266	        self.golden_per_param_grad_ready_counts = {}
267	        self.per_param_grad_ready_counts = {}
268	        self.is_last_microbatch = True
269	        self.is_first_batch = True
270	
271	        # Other metadata to keep track of collectives.
272	        self.param_gather_handle = None
273	        self.param_gather_dispatched = False
274	        self.grad_reduce_handle = None
275	        # Per-iteration flag: True once finish_grad_sync has run this step. Lets a successor
276	        # bucket group early-drain its predecessor without the end-of-step finalize loop
277	        # double-waiting. Reset by `reset()`.
278	        self.grad_reduce_finished = False
279	
280	        # Each time a local shard is created from bucket.param_data or bucket.grad_data, it
281	        # introduces some CPU overheads. We use these two lists to cache the created local
282	        # shards to avoid unnecessary CPU operations. This does not increase GPU memory usage
283	        # because it only saves a slice view, which shares the same memory with bucket.param_data
284	        # or bucket.grad_data.
285	        self.cached_param_buffer_shard_list = [None] * len(self.buckets)
286	        self.cached_grad_buffer_shard_list = [None] * len(self.buckets)
287	
288	    def reset(self):
289	        """
290	        Reset metadata in bucket group in preparation for the next iteration of training.
291	        """
292	        if self.is_first_batch and len(self.per_param_grad_ready_counts) > 0:
293	            # Record golden per_param_grad_ready_counts.
294	            assert len(self.per_param_grad_ready_counts) == len(self.params)
295	            self.golden_per_param_grad_ready_counts = self.per_param_grad_ready_counts
296	            self.is_first_batch = False
297	        self.per_param_grad_ready_counts = {}
298	        self.is_last_microbatch = True
299	        self.grad_reduce_finished = False

301	    def _post_param_sync(self):
302	        """Run post-processing after param all-gather completes."""
303	        if self.ddp_config.reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag:
304	            for bucket in self.buckets:
305	                if bucket.param_data is None:
306	                    # LayerWise variable-size gather path: params are already updated via
307	                    # unflatten + copy_ in finish_param_sync, and there is no param_data
308	                    # buffer to copy back from.
309	                    continue
310	                has_non_quantized_weight = False
311	                quantized_params = []
312	                param_slices = []
313	                flat_param_data = bucket.param_data.view(-1)
314	                for param in bucket.params:
315	                    # Non-quantized weights are already mapped to param.data. Skip
316	                    # mixed buckets because zeroing bucket.param_data would also
317	                    # clear those model weights.
318	                    if not _param_uses_quantized_storage(param):
319	                        has_non_quantized_weight = True
320	                        break
321	                    param_start, param_end = bucket.param_to_index[param]
322	                    quantized_params.append(param)
323	                    param_slices.append(flat_param_data[param_start:param_end])
324	                # Cast the bucket in one call: these casts are small, so the per-param cost of
325	                # issuing them is worth avoiding.
326	                copy_tensors_to_quantized_params(quantized_params, param_slices)
327	                if has_non_quantized_weight:
328	                    continue
329	                # All-gathered params are not needed after being copied to param.data.
330	                # Zero out the param buffer (shared with grad buffer) for gradient accumulation.
331	                # We cannot zero out the entire grad buffer because one grad buffer may
332	                # correspond to multiple param buffers. If we zero out the entire grad buffer,
333	                # it would clear the data of those param buffers that have not yet completed AG.
334	                bucket.param_data.zero_()
335	            return
336	
337	        quantized_params = []
338	        for bucket in self.buckets:
339	            for param in bucket.params:
340	                if _param_uses_quantized_storage(param):
341	                    quantized_params.append(param)
342	        if len(quantized_params) > 0:
343	            post_all_gather_processing(quantized_params)

345	    def check_grads(self, check_for_nan_or_inf, check_for_large):
346	        """
347	        Make sure norm of grads in bucket are not NaN prior to data-parallel
348	        all-reduce / reduce-scatter.
349	        """
350	        rerun_state_machine = get_rerun_state_machine()
351	        for i in range(len(self.buckets)):
352	            grad_norm = self.buckets[i].grad_data.norm(p=2)
353	            # check for NaN, Inf and unexpectedly large grads
354	            if check_for_nan_or_inf:
355	                rerun_state_machine.validate_result(
356	                    result=grad_norm,
357	                    rejection_func=torch.isnan,
358	                    message=f"found NaN in local grad norm for bucket #{i} "
359	                    f"in backward pass before data-parallel communication collective",
360	                    tolerance=0.001,  # 0.1% tolerance to account for non-deterministic FA backward
361	                    fatal=True,
362	                )
363	                rerun_state_machine.validate_result(
364	                    result=grad_norm,
365	                    rejection_func=torch.isinf,
366	                    message=f"found Inf in local grad norm for bucket #{i} "
367	                    f"in backward pass before data-parallel communication collective",
368	                    tolerance=0.001,  # 0.1% tolerance to account for non-deterministic FA backward
369	                    fatal=True,
370	                )
371	            if check_for_large:
372	                rerun_state_machine.validate_result(
373	                    result=grad_norm,
374	                    rejection_func=partial(
375	                        rerun_state_machine.is_unexpectedly_large, threshold=10, context="grads"
376	                    ),
377	                    message=f"found unexpected large grads in bucket #{i} "
378	                    f"in backward pass before data-parallel communication collective",
379	                    tolerance=0.001,  # 0.1% tolerance to account for non-deterministic FA backward
380	                    fatal=False,
381	                )

383	    def start_param_sync(self, force_sync: bool = False):
384	        """
385	        Initiates all necessary param all-gathers for this bucket.
386	
387	        When ddp_config.overlap_param_gather is set to True, dispatches an asynchronous
388	        communication call (unless force_sync is True). When ddp_config.overlap_param_gather
389	        is set to False, makes synchronous call.
390	
391	        Args:
392	            force_sync (bool, optional): force synchronous collective regardless of
393	                other settings if true.
394	        """
395	        # overlap_param_gather covers the layer-wise optimizer case, which sets
396	        # overlap_param_gather=True without use_distributed_optimizer.
397	        assert self.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer or self.ddp_config.overlap_param_gather
398	
399	        if force_sync:
400	            if self.param_gather_handle is not None:
401	                self.param_gather_handle.wait()
402	                self.param_gather_handle = None
403	                self._post_param_sync()
404	                return
405	        else:
406	            assert self.param_gather_handle is None
407	
408	        async_op = self.ddp_config.overlap_param_gather and not force_sync
409	
410	        if not self.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer:
411	            # Legacy layer-wise optimizer path: use all_gather for variable-size
412	            # param gather.  Once all layerwise call sites set
413	            # ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer=True, this branch can be removed.
414	            #
415	            # Each rank may own a different number of params per bucket, so
416	            # layerwise_param_flat_sizes can vary across ranks.  PyTorch's NCCL
417	            # backend handles uneven tensor sizes in torch.distributed.all_gather
418	            # (falling back to grouped send/recv internally when sizes differ),
419	            # so no manual padding is needed.
420	            dp_size = self.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_size
421	            if dp_size == 1:
422	                # Single-rank group (e.g., expt_dp_size == 1): no all-gather needed.
423	                if force_sync and self.ddp_config.overlap_param_gather:
424	                    self._post_param_sync()
425	                self.param_gather_dispatched = True
426	                return
427	            local_rank = self.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_rank
428	            group = self.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_group
429	            layerwise_work_handles = []
430	            for bucket in self.buckets:
431	                # Use param dtype (e.g., bf16), NOT grad dtype (which may be
432	                # fp32 when grad_reduce_in_fp32 is enabled).
433	                param_dtype = bucket.params_list[0].dtype
434	
435	                if max(bucket.layerwise_param_flat_sizes) == 0:
436	                    bucket.layerwise_gather_list = None
437	                    continue
438	
439	                local_size = bucket.layerwise_param_flat_sizes[local_rank]
440	                total_gather_size = sum(bucket.layerwise_param_flat_sizes)
441	
442	                # Reuse grad_data as the all_gather receive buffer; it is idle
443	                # during forward and grad_dtype.element_size >= param_dtype.
444	                reuse_buf = bucket.grad_data.view(param_dtype)
445	                assert reuse_buf.numel() >= total_gather_size
446	
447	                # Partition reuse_buf into contiguous per-rank receive slices.
448	                gather_list = []
449	                offset = 0
450	                for i in range(dp_size):

450	                for i in range(dp_size):
451	                    size = bucket.layerwise_param_flat_sizes[i]
452	                    gather_list.append(reuse_buf[offset : offset + size])
453	                    offset += size
454	                local_slot_view = gather_list[local_rank]
455	
456	                # Flatten local params and copy into the local rank's slot.
457	                # Detach from autograd since start_param_sync may be called
458	                # during the forward pass where autograd is active.
459	                if local_size > 0:
460	                    # MXFP8 params can't be flattened (view(-1) unsupported); gather the
461	                    # fp32 master (param.main_param -> bf16), which the receive-side copy_
462	                    # re-quantizes. Non-mxfp8 params flatten as-is.
463	                    src_params = []
464	                    for p in bucket.layerwise_params_list[local_rank]:
465	                        if is_mxfp8tensor(p):
466	                            main_param = getattr(p, "main_param", None)
467	                            assert main_param is not None, (
468	                                "LayerWise mxfp8 param sync needs param.main_param (fp32 "
469	                                "master) to stage the all-gather source; got None."
470	                            )
471	                            src_params.append(main_param.to(param_dtype))
472	                        else:
473	                            src_params.append(p)
474	                    flat_local_params = _flatten_dense_tensors(src_params).detach()
475	                    local_slot_view.copy_(flat_local_params)
476	                bucket.layerwise_gather_list = gather_list
477	
478	                work = torch.distributed.all_gather(
479	                    gather_list, local_slot_view, group=group, async_op=async_op
480	                )
481	                if async_op and work is not None:
482	                    layerwise_work_handles.append(work)
483	
484	            if async_op:
485	                self.param_gather_handle = _LayerwiseAllGatherHandle(layerwise_work_handles)
486	            else:
487	                # Synchronous: unflatten and copy gathered params immediately.
488	                for bucket in self.buckets:
489	                    if bucket.layerwise_gather_list is None:
490	                        continue
491	                    for idx, params in enumerate(bucket.layerwise_params_list):
492	                        if len(params) == 0 or idx == local_rank:
493	                            continue
494	                        updated_params = _unflatten_dense_tensors(
495	                            bucket.layerwise_gather_list[idx], params
496	                        )
497	                        for updated_p, model_p in zip(updated_params, params):
498	                            model_p.data.copy_(updated_p)
499	                    bucket.layerwise_gather_list = None
500	                    # Zero out grad_data since it was reused as the all-gather
501	                    # receive buffer. Without this, accumulation into main_grad
502	                    # (a view into grad_data) would start from the result of the
503	                    # latest parameter all-gather instead of zero.
504	                    bucket.grad_data.zero_()
505	                self.param_gather_handle = None
506	        else:
507	            # Standard distributed optimizer path: use _coalescing_manager.
508	            # all_gather_into_tensor writes directly into a contiguous output buffer and
509	            # does not need a copy-back step, so coalescing works correctly.
510	            with _coalescing_manager(
511	                self.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_group, async_ops=async_op
512	            ) as cm:
513	                for idx, bucket in enumerate(self.buckets):
514	                    if self.cached_param_buffer_shard_list[idx] is None:
515	                        self.cached_param_buffer_shard_list[idx] = shard_buffer(
516	                            bucket.param_data, self.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_size
517	                        )

542	        is True.

547	        False.

556	        # AG bucket in first model chunk if ddp_config.align_param_gather is False).

560	        if self.param_gather_handle is not None:
561	            self.param_gather_handle.wait()
562	            self.param_gather_handle = None

564	            if self.next_param_gather_bucket_group is not None and not skip_next_bucket_dispatch:

580	                    for idx, params in enumerate(bucket.layerwise_params_list):

583	                            len(params) == 0

594	                    # receive buffer. Without this, accumulation into main_grad
595	                    # (a view into grad_data) would start from the result of the

600	    def start_grad_sync(self, force_all_reduce: Optional[bool] = False):
601	        """
602	        Initiates grad sync (all-reduce or reduce-scatter) communication operations
603	        for all buckets in the bucket group.
604	
605	        When ddp_config.overlap_grad_reduce is set to True, dispatches an asynchronous
606	        communication call. When ddp_config.overlap_grad_reduce is set to False, makes
607	        synchronous call.
608	        """
609	        if self.is_first_batch and self.grad_reduce_handle is not None:
610	            # Make this start_grad_sync call a no-op if in first batch and collective has
611	            # already been dispatched.
612	            return
613	
614	        # Drain the predecessor bucket group's reduce-scatter before allocating ours. Only
615	        # linked under reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation, which holds an intermediate
616	        # all-to-all output tensor pinned until .wait() runs. We only drain when the
617	        # predecessor has actually been dispatched this iteration (grad_reduce_handle set):
618	        # backward param ordering does not always match bucket linkage order (e.g. NVFP4
619	        # bucket layouts), so the predecessor may not have fired yet when we arrive here.
620	        # In that case the predecessor will dispatch and drain on its own once its params
621	        # become ready. The end-of-step finalize loop still catches any bucket that
622	        # neither a successor nor itself drained.
623	        if (
624	            self.previous_grad_reduce_bucket_group is not None
625	            and self.previous_grad_reduce_bucket_group.grad_reduce_handle is not None
626	        ):
627	            self.previous_grad_reduce_bucket_group.finish_grad_sync(
628	                force_all_reduce=force_all_reduce
629	            )
630	
631	        assert (
632	            self.grad_reduce_handle is None
633	        ), "Should not have multiple communication calls outstanding at once"

635	        # Local CUDA graph replay is asynchronous with respect to the outer
636	        # autograd hooks. Wait before reading, scaling, or reducing gradients
637	        # accumulated by a replay into this bucket.
638	        current_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream()
639	        waited_event_ids = set()
640	        for bucket in self.buckets:
641	            for param in bucket.params_list:
642	                event = getattr(param, "_cudagraph_wgrad_ready_event", None)
643	                if event is not None and id(event) not in waited_event_ids:
644	                    current_stream.wait_event(event)
645	                    waited_event_ids.add(id(event))
646	
647	        # Copy accumulated .main_grad into communication buffer before collective if
648	        # .main_grad is not in .grad_data already (e.g., because we want to do local
649	        # gradient accumulation in a higher precision).
650	        for bucket in self.buckets:
651	            for param in bucket.params_with_extra_main_grads:
652	                if getattr(param, 'main_grad_copy_in_grad_buffer', None) is not None:
653	                    param.main_grad_copy_in_grad_buffer.copy_(param.main_grad)
654	
655	        if self.ddp_config.check_for_nan_in_grad or self.ddp_config.check_for_large_grads:

658	                check_for_large=self.ddp_config.check_for_large_grads,
659	            )
660	
661	        # gradient_scaling_factor already takes into account whether we are computing
662	        # an average or sum in the data-parallel collective.
663	        # This mutates gradient communication state and must not be tracked by autograd.
664	        with torch.no_grad():

683	            self.ddp_config.overlap_grad_reduce

756	                    torch.distributed.all_reduce(

763	        if async_op:

771	                    len(self.buckets) == 1
772	                ), "Only 1 bucket supported with reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation=True"

787	    def finish_grad_sync(self, force_all_reduce: Optional[bool] = False):
788	        """
789	        Finishes grad sync (all-reduce or reduce-scatter) communication operations
790	        for all buckets in the bucket group.
791	
792	        When ddp_config.overlap_grad_reduce is set to True, waits for asynchronous
793	        communication call to complete. When ddp_config.overlap_grad_reduce is set to False,
794	        makes synchronous call.
795	
796	        When ddp_config.overlap_grad_reduce is set to True, this method is idempotent
797	        within an iteration: a second call is a no-op. This lets a successor bucket
798	        group early-drain its predecessor at dispatch time (see
799	        `previous_grad_reduce_bucket_group`) while still allowing the end-of-step
800	        finalize loop to call this on every bucket without double-waiting. The
801	        non-overlap path preserves its original per-call dispatch+wait behaviour

805	        # If overlap_grad_reduce is False, start (and finish) synchronous communication call here.
806	        if not self.ddp_config.overlap_grad_reduce:
807	            self.start_grad_sync(force_all_reduce=force_all_reduce)

809	            return
810	        if self.grad_reduce_finished:

812	        # If first batch, start asynchronous communication here. register_grad_ready() launches
813	        # asynchronous communication only once self.golden_per_param_grad_ready_counts is

815	        if self.is_first_batch:
816	            self.start_grad_sync(force_all_reduce=force_all_reduce)

826	            f"({len(self.per_param_grad_ready_counts)}/{len(self.params)} "

832	        self.grad_reduce_finished = True

848	    def _copy_back_extra_main_grads(self):
849	        """
850	        Copy reduced gradients from the communication buffer back to .main_grad for
851	        params that have a separate higher-precision .main_grad tensor.
852	
853	        This is needed because the optimizer reads from .main_grad to get the reduced
854	        gradients, but for params with extra main_grads, .main_grad points to the local
855	        FP32 accumulation tensor rather than the communication buffer where the reduced
856	        gradients are stored.

858	        for bucket in self.buckets:

870	        grads as ready when processing the last microbatch and ddp_config.overlap_grad_reduce
871	        is True.

875	        ), "register_grad_ready() should only be called when overlap_grad_reduce is True"
876	        if self.is_last_microbatch:

880	            self.per_param_grad_ready_counts[param] += 1

888	def group_params_for_buffers(
889	    params: List[torch.nn.Parameter], grad_reduce_in_fp32: bool
890	) -> Dict['BufferKey', Tuple[List[torch.nn.Parameter], List[int]]]:
891	    """Group parameters by buffer identity for buffer allocation.
892	
893	    Each distinct buffer is identified by a BufferKey with three dimensions:
894	    - param_dtype: storage dtype (torch.uint8 for FP8/NVFP4 parameters, else param.dtype).
895	    - grad_dtype: gradient reduction dtype (torch.float if grad_reduce_in_fp32, else param.dtype).
896	    - is_expert_parallel: whether the parameter uses the expert topology (param.allreduce == False),
897	      which requires a separate buffer for the expert data-parallel group. This is true for experts
898	      when expert-parallelism > 1, expert-tensor-parallelism != tensor-parallelism, or expert-GTP
899	      != GTP.

900	
901	    The param_indices track each parameter's position among same-dtype params (using
902	    the "fake" high-precision dtype for FP8/NVFP4 params), needed for loading non-native-fp8
903	    checkpoints in native-fp8 mode.
904	
905	    Args:
906	        params: List of parameters to group.
907	        grad_reduce_in_fp32: Whether gradients are reduced in FP32.
908	
909	    Returns:
910	        Dict mapping BufferKey to (params_list, param_indices).
911	    """
912	    from ..optimizer.param_layout import BufferKey
913	
914	    key_to_params = {}
915	    dtype_to_offsets = {}
916	    key_to_indices = {}
917	
918	    for param in params:
919	        assert param.requires_grad
920	
921	        param_dtype = param.dtype
922	        if _param_uses_quantized_storage(param):
923	            param_dtype = torch.uint8
924	        grad_dtype = torch.float if grad_reduce_in_fp32 else param.dtype
925	        is_expert_parallel = not getattr(param, 'allreduce', True)
926	        is_managed_by_layer_wise_optimizer = getattr(
927	            param, 'is_managed_by_layer_wise_optimizer', False
928	        )
929	
930	        key = BufferKey(
931	            param_dtype, grad_dtype, is_expert_parallel, is_managed_by_layer_wise_optimizer
932	        )
933	        param_list = key_to_params.get(key, [])
934	        param_list.append(param)
935	        key_to_params[key] = param_list
936	
937	        # Use param.dtype (not param_dtype) so FP8/NVFP4 params share offsets with their
938	        # logical high-precision dtype, needed for checkpoint compatibility.
939	        offset_key = BufferKey(
940	            param.dtype, grad_dtype, is_expert_parallel, is_managed_by_layer_wise_optimizer
941	        )
942	        offset = dtype_to_offsets.get(offset_key, 0)
943	        dtype_to_offsets[offset_key] = offset + 1
944	        indices = key_to_indices.get(key, [])
945	        indices.append(offset)
946	        key_to_indices[key] = indices
947	
948	    result = {}
949	    for key, param_list in key_to_params.items():
950	        result[key] = (param_list, key_to_indices[key])
951	    return result

954	def _compute_default_per_buffer_param_layout(
955	    params: List[torch.nn.Parameter], bucket_size: Optional[int]
956	) -> 'PerBufferParamLayout':
957	    """Compute parameter layout for the non-distributed-optimizer case.
958	
959	    No padding is applied. Parameters are iterated in reverse order (backprop order)
960	    and grouped into buckets of approximately `bucket_size` elements.
961	
962	    Args:
963	        params: List of parameters to lay out.
964	        bucket_size: Approximate number of elements per bucket, or None for a single bucket.
965	
966	    Returns:
967	        PerBufferParamLayout with the computed mapping.
968	    """
969	    from ..optimizer.param_layout import PerBufferParamLayout
970	
971	    param_index_map = {}
972	    bucket_indices = []
973	    per_bucket_numel_unpadded = []
974	
975	    param_start_index = 0
976	    bucket_start_index = 0
977	    bucket_params = set()
978	    bucket_id = 0
979	
980	    for param in params[::-1]:
981	        this_numel = param.data.nelement()
982	        param_end_index = param_start_index + this_numel
983	        param_index_map[param] = (param_start_index, param_end_index, bucket_id)
984	        bucket_params.add(param)
985	
986	        if bucket_size is not None and (param_end_index - bucket_start_index) >= bucket_size:
987	            per_bucket_numel_unpadded.append(param_end_index - bucket_start_index)
988	            bucket_indices.append((bucket_start_index, param_end_index))
989	            bucket_start_index = param_end_index
990	            bucket_params = set()
991	            bucket_id += 1
992	        param_start_index = param_end_index
993	
994	    if len(bucket_params) > 0:
995	        per_bucket_numel_unpadded.append(param_end_index - bucket_start_index)
996	        bucket_indices.append((bucket_start_index, param_end_index))
997	
998	    return PerBufferParamLayout(
999	        param_index_map=param_index_map,
1000	        bucket_indices=bucket_indices,
1001	        per_bucket_numel_unpadded=per_bucket_numel_unpadded,
1002	    )

1446	        - 64-element alignment at the start of each param.

1450	            self.nvfp4_packed_param_index_map: param -> (start, end, bucket_id)

1535	        end_index = start_index + shape.numel()
1536	        if buffer_type == BufferType.PARAM:
1537	            numel = self.nvfp4_packed_numel if self.has_nvfp4_params else self.numel

1542	            assert end_index <= self.numel, "Requested tensor is out of grad buffer range"

1658	def partition_buckets(
1659	    buffers: List[_ParamAndGradBuffer],
1660	    force_single_bucket_group: bool = False,
1661	    reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation: bool = False,
1662	) -> List[_ParamAndGradBucketGroup]:
1663	    """
1664	    Automatically regroup the buckets of input buffers and return a list of bucket groups.
1665	
1666	    In some scenarios, we need to put buckets from different buffers into a group so that their
1667	    communication can be aggregated.
1668	
1669	    For example, when there are both fp8 weights and bf16 biases in the model and virtual
1670	    pipeline parallelism is enabled, each model chunk will have an fp8 bucket and a bf16 bucket,
1671	    which doubles the number of communication kernels, and because of the use of
1672	    CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=1, having multiple back-to-back communications will prevent the
1673	    overlap of communication kernels with computation kernels.
1674	
1675	    The grouping strategy is:
1676	    1. If force_single_bucket_group is True, put all buckets across all buffers into a single
1677	       bucket group.
1678	    2. If force_single_bucket_group is False, when there is no fp8 buffer in the input buffers,
1679	       let each bucket group have only one bucket.
1680	    3. If force_single_bucket_group is False, when using fp8 params, merge all non-fp8 buckets
1681	       into the last fp8 bucket group.
1682	       - Since the non-fp8 parameters (typically the biases of various layers) are relatively
1683	         small, they are likely to be grouped into a single non-fp8 bucket.
1684	       - The fp8 buckets start from the end of the model, i.e., the first bucket corresponds to
1685	         the end of the model, while the last bucket corresponds to the beginning.
1686	       - If we combine the non-fp8 bucket with the first fp8 bucket, we cannot initiate the
1687	         reduce-scatter to synchronize gradients after the backward pass at the end of the model
1688	         has completed. This is because we need to wait for the non-fp8 params from the beginning
1689	         layers to obtain their gradients.
1690	       - Combining the non-fp8 bucket with the last fp8 bucket can help avoid this issue.
1691	
1692	    Args:
1693	        buffers (list): list of input buffers.
1694	        single_bucket_group_per_buffer (bool, optional): force group all buckets in each buffer
1695	            into a single bucket group.
1696	    """
1697	
1698	    if len(buffers) == 0:
1699	        return []
1700	
1701	    # At most one fp8 (uint8) buffer is allowed; Cases 2 and 3 below branch on
1702	    # whether one is present. Non-uint8 dtypes can legitimately appear in
1703	    # multiple buffers (e.g. LayerWise-managed bf16 weights + Adam-managed bf16
1704	    # biases share the bf16 ``param_dtype`` but live in separate buffers), so
1705	    # the uniqueness check is restricted to uint8.
1706	    fp8_buffer = None
1707	    for buffer in buffers:
1708	        if buffer.param_dtype == torch.uint8:
1709	            assert fp8_buffer is None
1710	            fp8_buffer = buffer
1711	
1712	    # Case 1: Put all buckets into a single bucket group if force_single_bucket_group is True.
1713	    if force_single_bucket_group:
1714	        buckets = []
1715	        ddp_config = buffers[0].ddp_config
1716	        data_parallel_group = buffers[0].data_parallel_group
1717	        data_parallel_world_size = buffers[0].data_parallel_world_size
1718	        for buffer in buffers:
1719	            assert ddp_config == buffer.ddp_config
1720	            assert data_parallel_group == buffer.data_parallel_group
1721	            assert data_parallel_world_size == buffer.data_parallel_world_size
1722	            buckets.extend(buffer.buckets)
1723	
1724	        bucket_group = _ParamAndGradBucketGroup(
1725	            buckets, ddp_config, data_parallel_group, data_parallel_world_size
1726	        )
1727	        return [bucket_group]
1728	
1729	    if fp8_buffer is None:
1730	        # Case 2: When there is no fp8 buffer in the input buffers, let each bucket group have
1731	        #         only one bucket.
1732	        bucket_groups = []
1733	        for buffer in buffers:
1734	            for bucket in buffer.buckets:
1735	                bucket_groups.append(
1736	                    _ParamAndGradBucketGroup(
1737	                        [bucket],
1738	                        buffer.ddp_config,
1739	                        buffer.data_parallel_group,
1740	                        buffer.data_parallel_world_size,
1741	                    )
1742	                )
1743	        return bucket_groups
1744	    else:
1745	        # Case 3: When using fp8 params, merge all non-fp8 buckets into the last fp8 bucket group.
1746	        non_fp8_buckets = []
1747	        for buffer in buffers:
1748	            if buffer.param_dtype != torch.uint8:
1749	                for bucket in buffer.buckets:
1750	                    non_fp8_buckets.append(bucket)
1751	
1752	        bucket_groups = []
1753	        for bucket in fp8_buffer.buckets:
1754	            if len(bucket_groups) == len(fp8_buffer.buckets) - 1:
1755	                # reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation requires exactly one bucket
1756	                # per group (see assert in _ParamAndGradBucketGroup.reduce_scatter).
1757	                # Without this flag the non-FP8 buckets would be merged into the last
1758	                # FP8 group, violating that constraint. So we split them out into
1759	                # their own individual groups instead.
1760	                if reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation:
1761	                    bucket_groups.append(
1762	                        _ParamAndGradBucketGroup(
1763	                            [bucket],
1764	                            buffer.ddp_config,
1765	                            buffer.data_parallel_group,
1766	                            buffer.data_parallel_world_size,
1767	                        )
1768	                    )
1769	                    if non_fp8_buckets:
1770	                        for non_fp8_bucket in non_fp8_buckets:
1771	                            bucket_groups.append(
1772	                                _ParamAndGradBucketGroup(
1773	                                    [non_fp8_bucket],
1774	                                    buffer.ddp_config,
1775	                                    buffer.data_parallel_group,
1776	                                    buffer.data_parallel_world_size,
1777	                                )
1778	                            )
1779	
1780	                    continue  # Skip the default bucket group creation below
1781	                else:
1782	                    group_buckets = [bucket] + non_fp8_buckets
1783	            else:
1784	                # The first N-1 bucket groups.
1785	                group_buckets = [bucket]
1786	            bucket_groups.append(
1787	                _ParamAndGradBucketGroup(
1788	                    group_buckets,
1789	                    buffer.ddp_config,
1790	                    buffer.data_parallel_group,
1791	                    buffer.data_parallel_world_size,
1792	                )
1793	            )

40	def _unshard_if_dtensor(tensor: Union[torch.Tensor, "DTensor"]) -> torch.Tensor:
41	    """
42	    Unshards the input tensor if it is a DTensor and otherwise returns the
43	    tensor unmodified.
44	
45	    Args:
46	        tensor (Union[torch.Tensor, DTensor]): The tensor to potentially unshard.
47	
48	    Returns:
49	        An unsharded version of the input tensor if it is a DTensor, or the
50	        input tensor unmodified if it is not a DTensor.
51	    """
52	    if HAVE_DTENSOR and isinstance(tensor, DTensor):
53	        unsharded_tensor = tensor.full_tensor()
54	        for k, v in vars(tensor).items():
55	            setattr(unsharded_tensor, k, v)
56	        return unsharded_tensor
57	    return tensor

60	def _reshard_if_dtensor(
61	    tensor_to_shard: torch.Tensor, reference_tensor: Union[torch.Tensor, "DTensor"]
62	) -> Union[torch.Tensor, "DTensor"]:
63	    """
64	    Reshards the input tensor to match the sharding configuration of the
65	    reference tensor if the reference tensor is a DTensor. Otherwise, returns
66	    the reference tensor unmodified.
67	
68	    Args:
69	        tensor_to_shard (torch.Tensor): The tensor to be potentially sharded.
70	        reference_tensor (Union[torch.Tensor, DTensor]): The reference tensor
71	            for the sharding configuration.
72	
73	    Returns:
74	        Union[torch.Tensor, DTensor]: The sharded tensor matching the reference tensor's
75	        configuration, or the reference tensor itself if it is not a DTensor.
76	    """
77	    if HAVE_DTENSOR and isinstance(reference_tensor, DTensor):
78	        sharded_tensor = distribute_tensor(
79	            tensor_to_shard,
80	            device_mesh=reference_tensor.device_mesh,
81	            placements=reference_tensor.placements,
82	        )
83	        for k, v in vars(reference_tensor).items():
84	            setattr(sharded_tensor, k, v)
85	        return sharded_tensor
86	    return reference_tensor
