89	def _allreduce_conditional_embedding_grads(
90	    model: List[torch.nn.Module],
91	    config: TransformerConfig,
92	    pp_group: Optional[torch.distributed.ProcessGroup] = None,
93	):
94	    """
95	    All-reduce conditional embedding grads.
96	
97	    Reduce grads across all the pp stages to ensure that parameters of the conditional embedders
98	    (e.g., timestep embedder, FPS embedder, label embedder) stay in sync.
99	    This is for the models with replicated embedders on each PP / VPP rank, like diffusion models.
100	    """
101	    if pp_group is None:
102	        pp_group = parallel_state.get_pipeline_model_parallel_group()
103	
104	    if pp_group.size() > 1 and getattr(config, "has_cond_embedder", False):
105	        grads_dict = {}
106	        for model_chunk in model:
107	            for name, param in get_attr_wrapped_model(model_chunk, 'named_parameters')():
108	                if param.requires_grad and getattr(param, 'pipeline_parallel', False):
109	                    grad = param.main_grad
110	                    if name in grads_dict:
111	                        # Add all the virtual PP rank's gradients to
112	                        # the first local virtual PP rank.
113	                        grads_dict[name][0].add_(grad)
114	                        # Append to the end for later update after cross-rank reduce.
115	                        grads_dict[name].append(grad)
116	                    else:
117	                        grads_dict[name] = [grad]
118	        if grads_dict:
119	            # All-reduce the gradient on the first VPP rank.
120	            grads = [param_grad[0] for _, param_grad in grads_dict.items()]
121	            coalesced = _flatten_dense_tensors(grads)
122	            torch.distributed.all_reduce(coalesced, group=pp_group)
123	            for buf, synced in zip(grads, _unflatten_dense_tensors(coalesced, grads)):
124	                buf.copy_(synced)
125	
126	            # Update the gradients on other VPP ranks.
127	            for grads in grads_dict.values():
128	                for grad in grads[1:]:
129	                    grad.copy_(grads[0])

204	def _allreduce_embedding_grad(
205	    model: List[torch.nn.Module],
206	    embd_group: torch.distributed.ProcessGroup,
207	    pp_group: torch.distributed.ProcessGroup,
208	    weight_getter: Callable[[torch.nn.Module], Optional[torch.nn.Parameter]],
209	    skip_if_none: bool = True,
210	    config: TransformerConfig = None,
211	):
212	    """Unified helper to all-reduce embedding parameters across pipeline stages.
213	
214	    Args:
215	        model (List[torch.nn.Module]): A list of model chunks (PP/VPP).
216	        embd_group (torch.distributed.ProcessGroup): The process group over which to reduce.
217	        pp_group (torch.distributed.ProcessGroup): The pipeline parallel process group for
218	            first/last stage detection.
219	        weight_getter (Callable[[torch.nn.Module], Optional[torch.nn.Parameter]]): A function
220	            that takes the *pre-process* model chunk and returns the parameter to be reduced
221	            (or ``None`` if not applicable).
222	        skip_if_none (bool, optional): If True, quietly returns when the parameter or its
223	            gradient is ``None``. Defaults to True.
224	    """
225	
226	    if (
227	        # embd_group can be None in cases there is no embd_group
228	        # get_pg_size(embd_group) will return 1 and the all-reduce will be skipped.
229	        get_pg_size(embd_group) > 1
230	        and torch.distributed.get_rank() in torch.distributed.get_process_group_ranks(embd_group)
231	    ):
232	
233	        if is_pp_first_stage(pp_group):
234	            model_module = model[0]
235	        elif is_pp_last_stage(pp_group):
236	            model_module = model[-1]
237	        elif getattr(config, 'mtp_num_layers', None) is not None and config.mtp_num_layers > 0:
238	            # Embedding for MTP layers is in the last virtual pipeline model parallel stage.
239	            model_module = model[-1]
240	        else:  # We do not support an interleaved schedule for models with encoders yet.
241	            model_module = model[0]
242	
243	        ddp_config = model_module.ddp_config
244	        model_module = get_attr_wrapped_model(model_module, 'pre_process', return_model_obj=True)
245	
246	        weight = weight_getter(model_module)
247	        if weight is None and skip_if_none:
248	            return
249	
250	        grad_attr = _get_main_grad_attr(weight)
251	        orig_grad = getattr(weight, grad_attr)

278	def _allreduce_router_grads(model: List[torch.nn.Module], config: TransformerConfig):
279	    """
280	    All-reduce router grads.
281	
282	    Reduce grads across all the pp stages to ensure that parameters of the router stay in sync.
283	    """
284	
285	    if parallel_state.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size() > 1:
286	        grads_dict: Dict[str, List[torch.Tensor]] = {}
287	        for model_chunk in model:
288	            for name, param in get_attr_wrapped_model(model_chunk, 'named_parameters')():
289	                if param.requires_grad and getattr(param, 'flextron_router_pp_sync', False):
290	                    grad = param.main_grad
291	                    if name in grads_dict:
292	                        # Add all the virtual PP rank's gradients to
293	                        # the first local virtual PP rank.
294	                        grads_dict[name][0].add_(grad)
295	                        # Append to the end for later update after cross-rank reduce.
296	                        grads_dict[name].append(grad)
297	                    else:
298	                        grads_dict[name] = [grad]
299	
300	        if grads_dict:
301	            # All-reduce the gradient on the first VPP rank.
302	            grads = [param_grad[0] for _, param_grad in grads_dict.items()]
303	            coalesced = _flatten_dense_tensors(grads)
304	            torch.distributed.all_reduce(
305	                coalesced, group=parallel_state.get_pipeline_model_parallel_group()
306	            )
307	            for buf, synced in zip(grads, _unflatten_dense_tensors(coalesced, grads)):
308	                buf.copy_(synced)
309	
310	            # Update the gradients on other VPP ranks.
311	            for grads in grads_dict.values():
312	                for grad in grads[1:]:

336	    config: TransformerConfig,
337	    tp_dp_cp_group: Optional[torch.distributed.ProcessGroup] = None,
338	):
339	    """
340	    Update the expert bias of the router for a global batch.
341	    This requires all-reduce of local_tokens_per_expert across TPxCPxDP ranks
342	    """
343	    tokens_per_expert_list = []
344	    expert_bias_list = []
345	    for model_chunk in model:
346	        for module in get_attr_wrapped_model(model_chunk, 'modules')():
347	            # Only update expert_bias if this module is in the training mode. There are special
348	            # cases where only the student is in training mode but the teacher is in eval mode
349	            # when using online knoweldge-distillation with Model-Optimizer. In this case, we want
350	            # to avoid updating teacher's expert_bias.
351	            if (
352	                hasattr(module, 'expert_bias')

354	                and not getattr(module, 'frozen_expert_bias', False)
355	            ):

359	    if len(expert_bias_list) == 0:
360	        return

360	        return

367	        tp_dp_cp_group=tp_dp_cp_group,

374	def _update_router_qb_beta(
375	    model: List[torch.nn.Module],
376	    config: TransformerConfig,
377	    dp_cp_group: Optional[torch.distributed.ProcessGroup] = None,
378	):
379	    """Update the quantile-balancing per-expert bias once per global batch.
380	
381	    Averages each router's accumulated quantile (qb_beta_accum/qb_beta_count) across
382	    DP, EMA-blends it with the current qb_beta, re-centers, and writes it back.
383	    """
384	    qb_beta_list = []
385	    qb_beta_accum_list = []
386	    qb_beta_count_list = []
387	    for model_chunk in model:
388	        for module in get_attr_wrapped_model(model_chunk, 'modules')():
389	            if getattr(module, 'qb_beta_accum', None) is not None and module.training:
390	                qb_beta_list.append(module.qb_beta)
391	                qb_beta_accum_list.append(module.qb_beta_accum)
392	                qb_beta_count_list.append(module.qb_beta_count)
393	
394	    if len(qb_beta_list) == 0:
395	        return
396	
397	    stacked_beta = torch.stack(qb_beta_list, dim=0)
398	    local_avg_list = [
399	        accum / count.clamp(min=1).to(accum.dtype)
400	        for accum, count in zip(qb_beta_accum_list, qb_beta_count_list)
401	    ]
402	    stacked_local_avg = torch.stack(local_avg_list, dim=0)
403	
404	    torch.distributed.all_reduce(
405	        stacked_local_avg, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.AVG, group=dp_cp_group
406	    )
407	
408	    ema = config.moe_router_quantile_balancing_ema
409	    stacked_new_beta = ema * stacked_beta + (1.0 - ema) * stacked_local_avg
410	    stacked_new_beta = stacked_new_beta - stacked_new_beta.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
411	
412	    for qb_beta, new_beta in zip(qb_beta_list, stacked_new_beta):
413	        qb_beta.copy_(new_beta)

416	def _allreduce_non_tensor_model_parallel_grads(
417	    model: List[torch.nn.Module],
418	    config: TransformerConfig,
419	    tp_group: Optional[torch.distributed.ProcessGroup] = None,
420	):
421	    """
422	    All-reduce both layernorm grads (for sequence parallelism) and
423	    gradients from modules with average_gradients_across_tp_domain=True
424	    across tensor-model-parallel ranks.
425	    """
426	    tp_group = get_tensor_model_parallel_group_if_none(tp_group)
427	    if tp_group.size() <= 1:
428	        return
429	
430	    params_sum = []
431	    grads_sum = []
432	    params_avg = []
433	    grads_avg = []
434	
435	    for model_chunk in model:
436	        ddp_config = model_chunk.ddp_config
437	        for name, param in get_attr_wrapped_model(model_chunk, 'named_parameters')():
438	            if param.requires_grad:
439	                # Check if this param needs average reduction (average_gradients_across_tp_domain)
440	                if getattr(param, "average_gradients_across_tp_domain", False):
441	                    grad_attr = _get_main_grad_attr(param)
442	                    grad = getattr(param, grad_attr)
443	                    if grad is None:
444	                        continue
445	                    params_avg.append(param)
446	                    if ddp_config.use_megatron_fsdp:
447	                        grads_avg.append(grad._local_tensor.data)
448	                    else:
449	                        grad = _unshard_if_dtensor(grad)
450	                        grads_avg.append(grad.data)
451	                # Check if this param needs sum reduction (sequence parallel or qk_layernorm)
452	                elif (config.sequence_parallel and getattr(param, "sequence_parallel", False)) or (
453	                    config.qk_layernorm and ("q_layernorm" in name or "k_layernorm" in name)
454	                ):
455	                    grad_attr = _get_main_grad_attr(param)
456	                    grad = getattr(param, grad_attr)
457	                    if grad is None:
458	                        continue
459	                    params_sum.append(param)
460	                    if ddp_config.use_megatron_fsdp:
461	                        grads_sum.append(grad._local_tensor.data)
462	                    else:
463	                        grad = _unshard_if_dtensor(grad)
464	                        grads_sum.append(grad.data)
465	
466	    # Loop grads and perform correct all-reduce
467	    for params, grads, all_reduce_op in zip(
468	        [params_sum, params_avg],
469	        [grads_sum, grads_avg],
470	        [torch.distributed.ReduceOp.SUM, torch.distributed.ReduceOp.AVG],
471	    ):
472	        if grads:
473	            coalesced = _flatten_dense_tensors(grads)
474	            torch.distributed.all_reduce(coalesced, op=all_reduce_op, group=tp_group)
475	            for param, buf, synced in zip(
476	                params, grads, _unflatten_dense_tensors(coalesced, grads)
477	            ):
478	                buf.copy_(synced)
479	                grad_attr = _get_main_grad_attr(param)
480	                orig_grad = getattr(param, grad_attr)
481	                if ddp_config.use_megatron_fsdp:
482	                    setattr(param, grad_attr, orig_grad)
483	                else:
484	                    setattr(param, grad_attr, _reshard_if_dtensor(buf, orig_grad))

494	def _allreduce_replicated_grads_over_gtp_remat_group(
495	    model: List[torch.nn.Module],
496	    gtp_remat_group: Optional[torch.distributed.ProcessGroup],
497	    egtp_remat_group: Optional[torch.distributed.ProcessGroup],
498	    calculate_per_token_loss: bool = False,
499	):
500	    """Complete the gtp_remat / egtp_remat axis reduction for replicated parameters.
501	
502	    Replicated (non-gtp-sharded) params have a grad per gtp_remat peer (each from distinct data);
503	    the data-parallel collective only reduced the replicate axis, so the
504	    gtp_remat axis is still missing. How to complete it depends on the loss normalization:
505	
506	    - ``calculate_per_token_loss=False`` (default): the DP collective produced the 1/replicate mean,
507	      so a MEAN (AVG) over the gtp_remat axis yields the exact full (replicate x gtp) mean, keeping
508	      gradient scaling decoupled from the DP degree. (gtp_remat-sharded params self-average via
509	      their reduce-scatter mean and are skipped here.)
510	    - ``calculate_per_token_loss=True``: DDP applies NO 1/dp scaling; finalize divides every grad by
511	      1/total_global_tokens (which counts the gtp_remat peers' distinct tokens). The gtp_remat axis
512	      must therefore be SUM-reduced (like the DP axis) — an AVG would shrink each grad by 1/gtp.
513	
514	    No-op when GTP_remat is inactive (group size <= 1).
515	    """
516	    dense_active = gtp_remat_group is not None and gtp_remat_group.size() > 1
517	    expert_active = egtp_remat_group is not None and egtp_remat_group.size() > 1
518	    if not dense_active and not expert_active:
519	        return
520	
521	    dense_params, dense_grads = [], []
522	    expert_params, expert_grads = [], []
523	    for model_chunk in model:
524	        for name, param in get_attr_wrapped_model(model_chunk, 'named_parameters')():
525	            if not param.requires_grad or getattr(param, 'is_gtp_weight_remat', False):
526	                continue  # GTP-sharded params: their gtp_remat axis is handled by the RS-mean.
527	            grad_attr = _get_main_grad_attr(param)
528	            grad = getattr(param, grad_attr, None)
529	            if grad is None:
530	                continue
531	            grad = _unshard_if_dtensor(grad)
532	            if getattr(param, 'allreduce', True):
533	                dense_params.append(param)
534	                dense_grads.append(grad.data)
535	            else:
536	                expert_params.append(param)
537	                expert_grads.append(grad.data)
538	
539	    for params, grads, group in (
540	        (dense_params, dense_grads, gtp_remat_group),
541	        (expert_params, expert_grads, egtp_remat_group),
542	    ):
543	        if not grads or group is None or group.size() <= 1:
544	            continue
545	        coalesced = _flatten_dense_tensors(grads)
546	        # SUM vs AVG per the loss-normalization regime documented above.
547	        op = (
548	            torch.distributed.ReduceOp.SUM
549	            if calculate_per_token_loss
550	            else torch.distributed.ReduceOp.AVG
551	        )
552	        torch.distributed.all_reduce(coalesced, op=op, group=group)
553	        for param, buf, synced in zip(params, grads, _unflatten_dense_tensors(coalesced, grads)):
554	            buf.copy_(synced)
555	            grad_attr = _get_main_grad_attr(param)
556	            orig_grad = getattr(param, grad_attr)
557	            setattr(param, grad_attr, _reshard_if_dtensor(buf, orig_grad))

274	    def _detect_parallelism_type(self, param_name: str, module: nn.Module) -> Optional[str]:
275	        """
276	        Infer tensor-parallelism type for a parameter under a given module
277	        (forked from Megatron-Bridge).
278	
279	        Returns:
280	            "column", "row", or "replicated" if a type can be inferred, else None.
281	        """
282	        module_type = type(module).__name__
283	
284	        # Handle fused modules like TELayerNormColumnParallelLinear
285	        # These modules have both column-parallel weights (weight, bias)
286	        # and replicated layer norm weights (layer_norm_weight, layer_norm_bias)
287	        if module_type == "TELayerNormColumnParallelLinear":
288	            # Check the actual parameter name to determine the correct parallelism type
289	            if param_name.endswith("layer_norm_weight") or param_name.endswith("layer_norm_bias"):
290	                return "replicated"
291	            # All other parameters (weight, bias) are column-parallel
292	            return "column"
293	
294	        # Check registry first
295	        for parallelism, types in self._MODULE_TYPE_REGISTRY.items():
296	            if module_type in types:
297	                if parallelism == "row" and "bias" in param_name:
298	                    return "replicated"
299	                return parallelism
300	
301	        # Fallback to inspecting module attributes
302	        if hasattr(module, "tensor_model_parallel"):
303	            if not module.tensor_model_parallel:
304	                return "replicated"
305	
306	            # Check partition dimension
307	            partition_dim = getattr(module, "partition_dim", None)
308	            if partition_dim == 0:
309	                return "column"
310	            elif partition_dim == 1:
311	                if "bias" in param_name:
312	                    return "replicated"
313	                return "row"
314	
315	        # Fallback for normalization layers
316	        if any(norm in module_type for norm in ["Norm", "Normalization"]):
317	            return "replicated"
318	
319	        # Check parallel_mode for TELinear
320	        if module_type == "TELinear":
321	            if module.parallel_mode == "column":
322	                return "column"
323	            elif module.parallel_mode == "row":
324	                if "bias" in param_name:
325	                    return "replicated"
326	                return "row"
327	            else:
328	                return "replicated"
329	
330	        return None

535	            config, ddp_config, module, pg_collection, disable_bucketing

542	        self.ddp_config = ddp_config
543	
544	        if fsdp_unit_modules is None:
545	            fsdp_unit_modules = [TransformerLayer, MoETransformerLayer, MambaLayer]

547	        log_single_rank(

549	        )

551	            main_params_dtype=ddp_config.megatron_fsdp_main_params_dtype,
552	            main_grads_dtype=ddp_config.megatron_fsdp_main_grads_dtype,

562	        dp_group = pg_collection.dp_cp

569	            )
570	        placements = Placements(

572	        )
573	        # NCCL symmetric memory requires UB. MFSDP v2 intentionally does not support UB
574	        # without symmetric memory: it uses ncclCommRegister rather than the more performant
575	        # ncclCommWindowRegister:

616	        """Validate that the model and configuration are supported by MFSDP v2.
617	
618	        Args:
619	            config: Transformer configuration describing the requested model topology.
620	            ddp_config: Data-parallel and sharding configuration to validate.
621	            module: Model whose parameters are checked for expert parallelism.
622	            pg_collection: Materialized process groups whose topology must match the
623	                supported MFSDP v2 topology.
624	            disable_bucketing: Whether parameter bucketing is disabled.
625	
626	        Raises:
627	            ValueError: If a required process group is missing or the model,
628	                topology, or data-parallel configuration uses an unsupported feature.
629	        """
630	        if disable_bucketing:
631	            raise ValueError("MFSDP v2 does not support disabling bucketing.")
632	        if not hasattr(pg_collection, 'dp_cp'):
633	            raise ValueError("MFSDP v2 requires an explicit dp_cp process group.")
634	
635	        unsupported_parallelisms = [
636	            "tensor_model_parallel_size",
637	            "pipeline_model_parallel_size",
638	            "context_parallel_size",
639	        ]
640	        if any(getattr(config, parallelism) != 1 for parallelism in unsupported_parallelisms):
641	            raise ValueError(
642	                "MFSDP v2 does not currently support: "
643	                + ", ".join(
644	                    f"{parallelism}={getattr(config, parallelism)}"
645	                    for parallelism in unsupported_parallelisms
646	                )
647	            )
648	
649	        # The config validates the requested topology, while these checks validate the
650	        # materialized topology supplied by the caller's process-group collection.
651	        for group_name in ("tp", "pp", "cp"):
652	            group = getattr(pg_collection, group_name, None)
653	            if group is not None and group.size() != 1:
654	                raise ValueError(
655	                    f"MFSDP v2 currently requires {group_name.upper()} process-group size 1, "
656	                    f"got {group.size()}."
657	                )
658	
659	        if config.expert_model_parallel_size > 1:
660	            if (
661	                pg_collection.ep is None

669	                )
670	            if pg_collection.expt_dp is None:
671	                raise ValueError("MFSDP v2 with EP requires an explicit expert-DP process group.")
672	            if not any(isinstance(submodule, MoELayer) for submodule in module.modules()):
673	                raise ValueError("MFSDP v2 with EP requires MoE transformer layers.")
674	        if ddp_config.data_parallel_sharding_strategy != "optim_grads_params":
675	            raise ValueError(
676	                "MFSDP v2 requires data_parallel_sharding_strategy='optim_grads_params'."
677	            )
678	        if ddp_config.outer_dp_sharding_strategy != "no_shard":
679	            raise ValueError("MFSDP v2 does not currently support outer DP sharding.")
680	        if config.gradient_accumulation_fusion:
681	            raise ValueError("MFSDP v2 does not currently support gradient accumulation fusion.")
682	        if config.calculate_per_token_loss:

684	        if config.fp8 or config.fp4 or ddp_config.fp8_param_gather or ddp_config.fp4_param_gather:

686	        if config.cuda_graph_impl != "none" or ddp_config.megatron_fsdp_cuda_graph_mode:

689	        if ddp_config.fsdp_db_use_persist_buf_on_alloc_fail:
690	            raise ValueError(
691	                "MFSDP v2 does not support fsdp_db_use_persist_buf_on_alloc_fail: "

697	            raise ValueError("MFSDP v2 does not support fsdp_manual_registration.")
698	        if ddp_config.delay_wgrad_compute:

702	        if ddp_config.num_buckets is not None:
703	            raise ValueError("MFSDP v2 does not support num_buckets.")

30	_FSDP_CONTEXT = ContextVar[FsdpContext | None]("mfsdp_context", default=None)

33	@contextmanager
34	def fully_shard_context(
35	    device: torch.device | None = None, *, use_symmetric_memory: bool = False
36	) -> Iterator[FsdpContext]:
37	    """Construct FSDP modules that share runtime streams and prefetch orders.
38	
39	    Independent roots are ordered by their root-level ``fully_shard`` calls.
40	    Construction must finish before any of the registered modules run forward.
41	
42	    Args:
43	        device: CUDA device on which to create communication streams. Defaults to
44	            the current CUDA device.
45	        use_symmetric_memory: Allocate communication staging buffers from PyTorch's
46	            NCCL symmetric-memory pool.
47	    """
48	    if _FSDP_CONTEXT.get() is not None:
49	        raise RuntimeError("fully_shard_context does not support nesting.")
50	
51	    device = device or torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
52	    if device.type != "cuda":
53	        raise ValueError(f"fully_shard_context requires a CUDA device, got {device}.")
54	
55	    context = FsdpContext(device=device, use_symmetric_memory=use_symmetric_memory)
56	    token = _FSDP_CONTEXT.set(context)
57	    try:
58	        yield context
59	    except Exception:
60	        raise
61	    else:
62	        context.finalize()
63	    finally:
64	        _FSDP_CONTEXT.reset(token)
65

67	def fully_shard(
68	    module: nn.Module,
69	    mesh: DeviceMesh,
70	    placements: Placements,
71	    mixed_precision_policy: MixedPrecisionPolicy | None = None,
72	    grad_divisor: int = 1,
73	) -> None:
74	    """Apply FSDP to a module in place.
75	
76	    This attaches the FSDP mixin to the original module instance, so parent
77	    modules do not need to replace existing child-module references.
78	
79	    Args:
80	        module: Module whose currently unowned parameters are managed by FSDP.
81	        mesh: Device mesh used for sharding.
82	        placements: Parameter, gradient, and optimizer placements.
83	        mixed_precision_policy: Optional precision policy. Defaults to FP32 main weights
84	            and parameter-dtype main gradients.
85	        grad_divisor: Additional divisor applied to the reduced gradient, on top of the
86	            averaging the mesh already performs. Defaults to 1, which is correct whenever
87	            each mesh rank contributes exactly one term to the gradient.
88	
89	            Expert parallelism is the motivating case. A rank's experts process tokens
90	            routed to them from every rank in the expert-parallel group, and the backward
91	            pass routes those tokens' gradients back, so a rank's expert gradient already
92	            sums over ``ep_size`` ranks' data before any reduction happens. Averaging over
93	            the expert-data-parallel mesh alone therefore divides by too little, and
94	            ``grad_divisor=ep_size`` makes up the difference. Dense parameters see only
95	            their own rank's tokens and need no divisor.
96	    """
97	    if isinstance(module, FsdpModule):
98	        raise ValueError("This module is already managed by FSDP.")
99	    context = _FSDP_CONTEXT.get()
100	    if context is None:
101	        raise RuntimeError("fully_shard must run inside fully_shard_context.")
102	    for submodule in module.modules():
103	        if isinstance(submodule, FsdpModule) and submodule.context is not context:
104	            raise ValueError(
105	                "Cannot fully_shard a module containing an FSDP child from another "
106	                "fully_shard_context."
107	            )
108	
109	    placements = _normalize_placements(mesh, placements)
110	    mixed_precision_policy = mixed_precision_policy or MixedPrecisionPolicy()
111	    original_cls = module.__class__
112	    _attach_mixin(module)
113	    try:
114	        assert isinstance(module, FsdpModule)
115	        FsdpModule.__init__(
116	            module,
117	            context=context,
118	            mesh=mesh,
119	            placements=placements,
120	            mixed_precision_policy=mixed_precision_policy,
121	            grad_divisor=grad_divisor,
122	            use_symmetric_memory=context.use_symmetric_memory,
123	        )
124	    except Exception:
125	        module.__class__ = original_cls
126	        raise
127	
128	
129	def _normalize_placements(mesh: DeviceMesh, placements: Placements) -> Placements:
130	    """Return a copy with data-parallel mesh axes normalized to integer indices."""
131	    dp_axes = tuple(_axis_index(mesh, axis) for axis in placements.dp_axes)
132	    return dataclasses.replace(placements, dp_axes=dp_axes)
133	
134	
135	def _axis_index(mesh: DeviceMesh, axis: MeshAxis) -> int:
136	    if isinstance(axis, int):
137	        axis_index = axis
138	        if axis_index < 0:
139	            axis_index += mesh.ndim
140	        if axis_index < 0 or axis_index >= mesh.ndim:
141	            raise ValueError(f"Mesh axis {axis} is out of bounds for mesh ndim {mesh.ndim}.")
142	        return axis_index
143	
144	    dim_names = mesh.mesh_dim_names
145	    if dim_names is None or axis not in dim_names:
146	        raise ValueError(f"Mesh axis {axis!r} is not present in mesh dim names {dim_names}.")
147	    return dim_names.index(axis)

150	@contextmanager
151	def microbatch(context: FsdpContext, is_last: bool) -> Iterator[None]:
152	    """Mark an FSDP microbatch as the last accumulation microbatch.
153	
154	    At present, this is only needed for HSDP/HFSDP gradient accumulation, so
155	    FSDP finalizes gradients only on the last backward. Plain all-Flat data
156	    parallelism finalizes gradients on every backward and does not need it.
157	
158	    Args:
159	        context: FSDP context whose roots should use this microbatch state.
160	        is_last: Whether forwards in this scope are for the last microbatch.
161	    """
162	    context.ensure_finalized()
163	    previous_state = context.is_last_microbatch
164	    context.is_last_microbatch = is_last
165	
166	    try:
167	        yield
168	    finally:
169	        context.is_last_microbatch = previous_state

172	def _attach_mixin(module: nn.Module) -> None:
173	    if isinstance(module, FsdpModule):
174	        return
175	    module_cls = module.__class__
176	    fsdp_cls = type(f"ExperimentalFsdp{module_cls.__name__}", (FsdpModule, module_cls), {})
177	    module.__class__ = fsdp_cls
